performer.title: Profile and photos
performer.body: The profile is edited in the <link>My profile</link> section. For it to appear in the catalog, fill in your profile and upload at least 3 photos, then click "Submit for review" — an admin will review it. Photos are reviewed separately from the rest of the profile: each photo has its own status (Pending / Confirmed / Rejected), with the rejection reason shown right under the photo. After a rejection, click "Submit photos for review" again to send the rejected photos back for another review.

catalog.title: Catalog and search
catalog.body: All published profiles are available in the <link>catalog</link> — you can filter by city, type and other parameters there. Only profiles that have passed admin review appear in the catalog.

account.title: Account and personal cabinet
account.bodyLoggedIn: Your profile, chats and other sections are available in your <link>personal cabinet</link>.
account.bodyLoggedOut: Sign-in and registration are on the <link>sign-in</link> page. After signing in, your profile, chats and other sections are available in your personal cabinet.

chats.title: Chats
chats.body: Conversations with clients and performers happen in the <link>Chats</link> section. If sending messages has been restricted by an admin, this will be shown in the chat interface.

reviews.title: Reviews and reports
reviews.body: Clients can leave a review (rating and text) on a profile's page — it's published after moderator review. If a review, message, profile or user violates the rules, you can report it using the "Report" button, and an admin will review the report.
